subject: Text documentation in the background panel

messages.author: 05876d7dccb66035
messages.subject: Text documentation in the background panel
parts:
I have looked around and have not found any discussion of placing text in the background panel.

I want to put documentation below the X-axis. For example, data source information or branding text. 

Is there a function for placing text in the background panel? If not, are there tricks for accomplishing this within ggplot?

Thanks.

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Text documentation in the background panel
parts:
Hi,

Do you have an example?
I'd suggest simply using grid.text.
